name: thesis-mcwm-fresh-attribution-v26-20261023
selection: Freeze seed6202, algorithm, all-day primary endpoints and early/tail diagnostic windows before new outcomes. No seed, packet, checkpoint, window, feature, sampler or trust selection by results.
data_rights: Both arms admit285 factual current-state/action slots; fresh may train with their complete outcomes, no_fresh stores only s/a and replaces its64 critic slots with complete historical transitions. Diagnostic factual-history counts never enter learning. No target counterfactual queries.
prediction_comparison: No model-prediction candidate or family selection in this attribution pilot.
control_comparison: Each arm controls its own complete target day under equal seeds, scenario, history, source buffer, initialization, feedback times/record counts and policy-update budget. The full passenger ledger including unfinished passengers determines costs.
source_budget: Same archived4096 source rows; no additional source interaction.
interpretation: One new seed6202, four new days; fixed-algorithm development replication of seed6201 v25r1. All outcomes retained, no superiority or independent-confirmation claim.
estimation_target: Total effect of using admitted fresh factual outcomes for critic supervision, conditional on the same current-state/action access rule and matched optimization. Closed-loop trajectories may differ.

no_fresh.critic: complete historical transition replacement; no fresh r/ns/dt/terminal stored

data_permissions.diagnostic_native_history: Completed factual runs only; IssueAudit counts never enter actor, value, critic or label selection.

runtime_contract.optimizer_schedule: resident actor-before-critic including IQL V and Adam state

primary_endpoint: Full-day absolute2W+R per departed passenger, fresh-minus-no_fresh separately in stable and shock; waiting/riding decomposed, including unfinished passengers.
secondary_endpoints: 18300–24000 post-update costs using same final departed denominator
recovery if and only if preregistered early degradation exists

recovery.when_untriggered: no_detectable_early_degradation; onset and confirmed remain null

stages.dispatch: Stable and shock paired tasks submitted together; each starts two single-thread arms before waiting. Native algorithm is unchanged from the validated v25 implementation.
stages.completion: Wait for all four native days and integrity checks, regardless of effect signs.
stages.expansion: No further seeds or formal confirmation automatically submitted.

native_algorithm: v25 learning.py, IssueAudit, shared ExecutionAction and actual simulator clocks unchanged; local run reads this seed6202 protocol.

replication_reference.source: v25r1 review resident_endpoints.json; development reference fixed before seed6202 outcomes
